verdict.rationale: uv installs Python and switches between versions quickly (uv-docs-6, uv-docs-27), downloading versions as needed (uv-gh-6). `uv python pin` writes a checkable `.python-version` file per directory (uv-gh-1), and that pin is respected elsewhere, including in CI (uv-docs-50). Hands-on users report `uv run` handles the Python install automatically and replaced pyenv on mixed macOS/Linux teams (uv-comm-18, uv-comm-2). Missing for 10: tool versions pinned per project from a checked-in config (tool versions are only shown as CLI specifiers like `ruff@0.6.0` or global installs), and explicit docs that the `.python-version` pin auto-installs the runtime on checkout.
